brief: A cover to hide the cables behind my TV and keep them tidy.

requirements.requirement: Hide the cables behind the TV (enclosed cover/chase)

requirements.evidence: 2x cable comb accessories + hex-port-gland side port keep bundle ordered and give dedicated entry

finish.summary: 3-storey enclosed cable chase with cable-type top cover, capped sides, 2 cable combs and a cable gland port. Verified clear.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Tidying those TV cables — I'll build a discreet cover to hide them.
